title: Digital Marketing Agency in Detroit, MI
metaTitle: Digital Marketing Agency in Detroit, MI | TDM
metaDescription: Digital marketing for Detroit businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video for automotive suppliers, healthcare, restaurants and local services.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Detroit businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Detroit is the centre of the American car industry and of a metro area where most people live and shop in the suburbs. We help suppliers reach engineers and purchasing teams, and help local firms reach customers across the city, Oakland County and Macomb County without paying for the wrong ones.

sections.heading: The Motor City supply chain
paragraphs: General Motors is headquartered in Detroit, Ford in Dearborn and the North American arm of Stellantis in Auburn Hills. Around them sits a dense network of parts makers, tool and die shops, testing laboratories, engineering consultancies, software firms and staffing agencies, many of them in Warren, Troy, Southfield, Livonia and Novi.

These businesses sell to people who are busy and technical. A purchasing manager wants to see processes, capacity, quality certifications and the industries you already serve, and wants to send a request for quote without a phone call. We build that kind of site, target search terms that name specific capabilities, and use LinkedIn to reach defined job titles at the manufacturers and their main suppliers.

sections.heading: City, suburbs and the mile roads
paragraphs: Within Detroit, the districts that draw visitors and new businesses are well known: Downtown, with its offices, stadiums and theatres; Midtown, with the university, museums and hospitals; Corktown, where the restored train station has brought new activity; Eastern Market, with its food businesses and Saturday crowds; and New Center and Greektown.

Most of the metro's households, though, are in the suburbs, and each has a clear identity. Royal Oak and Ferndale have restaurants and nightlife, Birmingham and the Grosse Pointes are affluent, Dearborn is known for its restaurants and bakeries as well as for Ford, and Sterling Heights and Clinton Township are large residential communities in Macomb County. Residents give directions by mile roads and by Woodward, Gratiot and Telegraph, and they search by suburb name.
bullets: Pages for the suburbs and districts you serve, with real local detail.
Ad targeting set by drive time, since few people cross the metro for a routine service.
Separate budgets for Wayne, Oakland and Macomb where results differ.

sections.heading: Healthcare, finance and a rebuilt downtown
paragraphs: The car industry is not the whole story. Large health systems and the medical school in Midtown employ many thousands and support clinics and suppliers across the region. Mortgage and financial technology companies have filled downtown offices.

Detroit also sits on an international border. Windsor, Ontario is directly across the river, and the crossing is among the busiest trade routes between the United States and Canada. Customs brokers, freight firms and manufacturers with plants on both sides need websites and campaigns that speak to buyers in two countries.

sections.heading: What moves demand through the year
paragraphs: Cold winters keep furnace and plumbing companies busy and make snow removal a contract business. Spring opens the season for roofing, concrete, landscaping and home sales. The Woodward Dream Cruise in August, the auto show and home games for the Tigers, Lions, Red Wings and Pistons bring crowds that restaurants, bars and retailers can plan for. We set budgets and content against these patterns and your own figures.

presence: TDM works with Detroit businesses remotely. We have no office or team member in the city. Strategy, design, development and video are delivered online by our team, with scheduled calls and written reports.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Detroit?
faqs.a: No. We work with Detroit businesses remotely. Calls, shared documents and regular reports keep the work visible.

faqs.q: How do automotive suppliers in Detroit get leads online?
faqs.a: Buyers search for specific processes and capabilities, then check the supplier's site. Detailed capability pages, visible certifications, a short quote form and targeted LinkedIn and search campaigns bring enquiries from the right people. Sales cycles are long, so results are judged over months.

faqs.q: Should my business target Detroit or the suburbs?
faqs.a: Target where your customers live and how far they will drive. For many local services that means particular suburbs in Oakland, Macomb or Wayne County, each with its own page and budget, and not the whole metro at once.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Detroit?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on the scope of work. We discuss your goals in a free consultation and then provide a quote.

faqs.q: Can you market a Detroit company to Canadian customers?
faqs.a: Yes. We can build pages and campaigns for buyers in Ontario and elsewhere in Canada alongside your US marketing, with targeting and messaging set for each country.
